text: Principles of Aircraft Structural Design: Study the structural layout, load distribution and design methods of core components such as wings, fuselage and tail wings, for example, how to balance strength and weight through the optimization design of wing beams and stringers.Structural Mechanics and Strength Analysis: Covering elasticity mechanics, fracture mechanics, composite material structural mechanics, etc., used to analyze the stress state of the structure under aerodynamic loads, self-weight and extreme conditions, to avoid deformation or fracture.Aerospace Materials and Manufacturing Technology: Research the properties of aerospace materials such as aluminum alloys, titanium alloys, and composite materials, as well as the influence of advanced manufacturing processes such as welding and 3D printing on structural performance.
